papers.title: Investigation into spatter behavior during selective laser melting of AISI 316L stainless steel powder
papers.first_author_affiliation: School of Mechanical and Automotive Engineering, South China University of Technology, Guangzhou 510640, China

corresponding_authors.name: Yongqiang Yang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Mechanical and Automotive Engineering, South China University of Technology, Guangzhou 510640, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究SLM过程中的飞溅行为，未涉及生物医学植入物、多孔结构或应力屏蔽，与用户研究方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on spatter behavior during SLM of 316L stainless steel, with no biomedical context, no porous structure design, no mechanical testing relevant to implants, and no evaluation of fatigue or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM过程中飞溅行为的机理及影响因素
summary_zh.method: 通过高速摄像和图像分析观测不同工艺参数下的飞溅特征
summary_zh.result: 揭示了飞溅颗粒的尺寸、速度及分布与激光功率和扫描速度的关系
summary_zh.validation: 实验观测与理论分析结合

summary_en.motivation: To understand the mechanisms and influencing factors of spatter formation during selective laser melting
summary_en.method: High-speed imaging and image analysis were used to observe spatter characteristics under varying process parameters
summary_en.result: Relationships between spatter particle size, velocity, distribution and laser power, scanning speed were revealed
summary_en.validation: Experimental observation combined with theoretical analysis

papers.title: Prevalence and risk factors for intra-operative periprosthetic fractures in one thousand eight hundred and seventy two patients undergoing total hip arthroplasty: a cross-sectional study
authors: Patrícia Maria de Moraes Barros Fucs
papers.first_author_affiliation: Hip Clinic, Orthopaedic Department, Santa Casa Medical School and Hospitals, Santa Casa de Misericórdia de São Paulo, R. Dr Cesário Motta Jr, 112, São Paulo, SP, CEP 01221-020, Brazil

corresponding_authors.name: Walter Ricioli
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Hip Clinic, Orthopaedic Department, Santa Casa Medical School and Hospitals, Santa Casa de Misericórdia de São Paulo, R. Dr Cesário Motta Jr, 112, São Paulo, SP, CEP 01221-020, Brazil

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅关注临床并发症风险，未涉及生物力学建模或植入物设计。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical risk factor study without any biomechanical modeling, FEA, stress shielding, or micromotion analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 分析全髋关节置换术中假体周围骨折的发生率和风险因素。
summary_zh.method: 横断面研究，纳入1872例患者数据。
summary_zh.result: 确定了年龄、性别等独立危险因素。
summary_zh.validation: 临床数据统计分析验证。

summary_en.motivation: To determine the prevalence and identify risk factors for intra-operative periprosthetic fractures in total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A cross-sectional study of 1,872 consecutive patients undergoing total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.result: Independent risk factors included age, gender, and surgical approach.
summary_en.validation: Multivariate logistic regression analysis of clinical data.
